text: Kamala had a calm and restful day at home in Chennai today. Her morning routine began smoothly with kitchen activity starting at 8:02 AM for morning coffee, followed by reading the newspaper in the living room. The regular milk vendor delivered at the front door at 8:15 AM, and a courier brought a parcel at 11:30 AM. After lunch, she rested comfortably in the bedroom until 3:45 PM. A brief unrecognized visitor rang the doorbell at 3:10 PM without incident. Evening preparations in the kitchen were steady and on time. Overall, her daily activity stayed well within normal rhythms.
